create_metric_per_engine: create labeled prometheus metric children for each engine index using a Gauge, Counter, or Histogram
create_type_alias_PromMetric: create a PromMetric type alias representing a Gauge, Counter, or Histogram from prometheus_client
build_metric_dict_per_engine: build a dictionary mapping engine indices to labeled prometheus metric children
apply_labels_to_metric: apply label values to a prometheus metric to produce per-engine labeled metric instances
test_create_metric_per_engine: test the create_metric_per_engine function with sample engine indices and label values
